subject: Spot-check VM evidence for SOC 2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@riverview.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spot-check VM evidence request for SOC2 / SIG

Hi Jonas,

Riverview's SOC 2 auditor is performing a focused spot-check for our SIG/CAIQ submission and asked for a small sample of vulnerability management evidence from one of our vendors. We need: 

- Proof of scan cadence (authenticated internal scans, unauthenticated external scans) for the last 90 days
- A couple of sample scan outputs (with findings)
- Two remediation tickets showing end-to-end closure (ticket, PR, deploy) for recent CVEs, with timestamps
- A short attestation that critical/high CVEs are triaged and mitigated according to SLAs; please state your typical SLA windows

Can you send these to me by end-of-day Friday (2026-10-15)? Auditor prefers small PDFs or CSV exports; screenshots okay as supplements.

Also please include one-page language we can drop into the SIG response under "Vulnerability Management - Evidence". If you have a SOC 2-specific letter we can attach, that's even better.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Nguyen
Security Assurance Lead
Riverview Capital

Attachments: CAIQ_template_rev3.xlsx (customer-provided template)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@riverview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spot-check VM evidence request for SOC2 / SIG

Thanks Alyssa — we can do that. Looping in Marissa (sec ops) to pull the artifacts and Ben (CS) to help with delivery format for the auditor. High-level plan:

- I will attach a sample CSV export of the last weekly authenticated scan and a short remediation ledger export (see vm-spotcheck-scan-sample-20261011.csv).
- Marissa will add 2 full remediation traces (Jira -> PR -> deploy) as PDFs and provide the SLA attestation language.
- We'll include a one-page VM statement you can paste into SIG/CAIQ and a signed attestation text file.

We run weekly authenticated internal scans and monthly external full-surface scans; exception process for third-party patches is documented. For the spot-check I'll provide exact cadence timestamps and the ticket ids you requested. If auditor needs signed PDF via DocuSign, we can generate that — attaching a draft attestation as txt for now.

Jonas
Director, Partnerships (on behalf of Security Ops)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vm-spotcheck-scan-sample-20261011.csv (CSV), attestation-vm-draft.txt (text)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@riverview.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spot-check VM evidence request for SOC2 / SIG

Thanks — adding the operational detail below and attaching ticket snapshots. I also pasted the one-page SIG-friendly statement at the end for convenience.

Operational cadence (summary):
- Authenticated internal scans: weekly (every Tuesday 02:00 UTC) — agent-based authenticated credentialed scans against internal build images and staging clusters.
- External unauthenticated scans: monthly (first Wednesday of month 03:30 UTC) — full-surface external scans run from two vendor nodes.
- Container image vulnerability scans: on-build (CI) and daily image registry sweep.

SLA / Triage windows we follow (standardized):
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 or known RCE with exploit): acknowledge within 24 hours; mitigation plan within 7 days; production remediation/mitigation within 30 days unless vendor patch required (we document compensating controls).
- High (CVSS 7.0–8.9): acknowledge within 72 hours; remediation tracked and typically closed within 30–60 days depending on testing windows.
- Medium/Low: risk-based cadence; typically 90 days for medium unless escalated.

Attached artifacts (sample exports):
- remediation-jira-snapshots.pdf — two full ticket traces (JIRA-98451, JIRA-99102) showing creation, owner assignment, PR link, CI/CD pipeline run, and deploy timestamp.
- vm-spotcheck-scan-sample-20261011.csv — weekly authenticated scan CSV (sample with slugs redacted).
- attestation-vm-20261015.txt — short signed attestation language.

Short attestation (copy/paste friendly):
"Redwood Inference attests that our vulnerability management program maintains weekly authenticated scanning and monthly external scanning, and that critical and high-severity findings are triaged and remediated in accordance with our published SLAs. For critical findings, we acknowledge within 24 hours and follow a mitigation plan within 7 days with production remediation targeted within 30 days where feasible. Signed: Marissa Cole, Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference."

If the auditor needs signed PDF/DocuSign, I can kick that off once Alyssa confirms the recipient.

Marissa
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation-jira-snapshots.pdf (PDF)
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@riverview.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spot-check VM evidence request for SOC2 / SIG

Marissa — this is helpful, thank you. A couple of follow-ups from the auditor:

1) Can you provide the actual JIRA IDs and a screenshot of the deploy job output for the two ticket examples (we need to validate timestamps match the ticket closure)?
2) Auditor asked for verification for two specific CVEs: CVE-2026-1234 and CVE-2026-2345 — can you confirm whether those were detected in your scans and, if so, provide the ticket IDs and closure dates (or confirm not detected)?
3) For the attestation, they prefer a signed PDF. Please send the DocuSign link or signed PDF by Oct 15 COB.

Small note: auditor prefers artifacts with immutable trace (Jira ticket + pipeline run + PR link) rather than screenshots alone. If you need to redact any internal IPs, that's fine, but timestamps need to be intact.

Thanks — Alyssa

Attachment: CAIQ_template_rev3_filled.xlsx (they attached a prefilled row to place the one-page text)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@riverview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spot-check VM evidence request for SOC2 / SIG

Alyssa — final deliverable attached. Summary below for auditor quick review:

- JIRA-98451: linked to CVE-2026-1234 (detected 2026-09-07); ticket opened 2026-09-08 04:15 UTC, PR #4321 opened 2026-09-09 10:02 UTC, CI pipeline run 2026-09-10 02:11 UTC (artifact included), deploy to production 2026-09-11 22:47 UTC. Evidence: remediation-jira-snapshots.pdf (pages 1-3).
- JIRA-99102: linked to CVE-2026-2345 (detected 2026-08-30); ticket opened 2026-08-31 09:22 UTC, PR #4108 opened 2026-09-02 15:30 UTC, CI pipeline run 2026-09-03 01:38 UTC, deploy 2026-09-04 20:10 UTC. Evidence: remediation-jira-snapshots.pdf (pages 4-6).

Both CVEs were detected in our scans and fully mitigated per the ticket traces attached. We redacted internal hostnames and IPs but preserved timestamps and PR/CI links for immutability.

Signed attestation (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABCDEF — I initiated a DocuSign envelope addressed to security@riverview.com; you should see it in your inbox. If the auditor prefers a direct signed PDF, Marissa has exported the signed copy and it's attached as attestation-vm-20261015.txt (plain text of signed block) and we can convert to PDF on request.

Ben will coordinate a short call if the auditor wants to walk through the traces.

Thanks — let me know if anything else is required.

Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation-jira-snapshots.pdf (PDF), attestation-vm-20261015.txt (signed attestation text)
